ADMIN_TAB_PRISON_DESC: Where jailed players sleep, where they walk out and the area they may not leave.
ADMIN_C_CELLS_DESC: A jailed player starts at a random cell point and walks out at the release point when the time is served.
ADMIN_H_RELEASE: Where a player stands after the sentence ends (outside the gate).
ADMIN_C_AREA_DESC: A jailed player outside this area counts as escaping: back to a cell with extra time.
ADMIN_H_ZONE: Walk around the prison walls and add a corner at each turn (at least three).
ADMIN_H_ZONE_HEIGHT: Metres above and below the corners that still count as inside.
ADMIN_C_CANTEEN_DESC: A counter where jailed players get a meal for free.
ADMIN_H_CANTEEN_ITEM: The item handed out; empty closes the canteen.
ADMIN_H_CANTEEN_MINUTES: Minutes before the same character gets another meal.
ADMIN_TAB_RULES_DESC: How long sentences may be, what happens to items and to escapes.
ADMIN_C_SENTENCE_DESC: The server counts the minutes; players cannot change them.
ADMIN_H_MAX_MINUTES: Longer sentences from police or admins are cut to this.
ADMIN_H_COUNT_OFFLINE: On: minutes pass while the player is away too. Off: only time in the game counts.
ADMIN_H_CONFISCATE: On: the inventory is taken when jailed and given back at release.
ADMIN_C_ESCAPE_DESC: What happens when a jailed player leaves the prison area.
ADMIN_H_ESCAPE_PENALTY: Minutes added each time a jailed player is found outside the area.
ADMIN_H_ESCAPE_ALERT: Sends a police alert with the escape position.
ADMIN_TAB_TASKS_DESC: Spots where jailed players work to serve their time faster.
ADMIN_DELETE_TASK_DESC: Players can no longer work at this spot.
ADMIN_C_TASK_DESC: A jailed player works here for a few seconds and serves part of the sentence.
ADMIN_H_TASK_COORDS: Stand where the player should work and use your position.
ADMIN_H_TASK_MINUTES: How much shorter the sentence gets each time.
ADMIN_H_TASK_COOLDOWN: Seconds before the same character can work at this spot again.
PRISON_JAILED: You were sent to prison for {0} minutes.
PRISON_SERVED: You served your sentence. You are free.
PRISON_ESCAPE_CAUGHT: You were caught leaving the prison: {0} minutes added.
ALERT_ESCAPE_MESSAGE: An inmate was seen outside the prison walls.
